Hello ​@kamran78p,

The list of supported microcontrollers (MCUs) is available in the release note document through Workbench tool > About > Documentations.
The release note document also lists the MCU series that support the dual-drive feature:
“This feature is only supported on STM32G4xx, STM32F3xx and STM32F4xx MCUs related boards.”
than what i can do i have custom ,otor control board with stm32f103rct6 any posibility

Hello ​@kamran78p,

Develop a dual-drive project.
A single-drive STM32 Nucleo-F103RB project generated with MCSDK 5.4.8 can serve as a starting point. The MCU can be switched to the STM32F103RC in the MCU and Clock Freq box.
A MCSDK 5.4.8 dual-motors project can also serve as a starting point.

Hello ​@kamran78p,

For MCSDK 5.4.8, STM32CubeMX 6.4.0 is recommended, as stated in the MCSDK release notes available in the MC Workbench tool > Documentation.
